rows.text: Direct an original Nian through surprise, joy and a greeting.

This year, Nian wants to greet everyone with a performance. Eyebrows, eyes and mouth must work together. A misplaced expression changes the message. Turn surprise into joy, then finish with a bow. You are the director.
